Messages.Author: jeroen rombouts
Messages.Body:
"Jozxyqk" <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote in message
news:gFRg6.2359$H_3.6...@typhoon.ne.mediaone.net...

> Can Political Action Modifiers/Reactions be used during a Blood Hunt vote?
> Or only by a "Political Action" card?
>

Most of these say: only usable during a political action (or referendum).
Calling a Bloodhunt is not a political action, so, by card text, you cannot
use them.

The exeption to this (i think) is Ventrue HQ, it just says: tap to gain 3
votes.

Jeroen
